cases.name: source-ownership-exploration
cases.purpose: Answer one scoped repository question without mutation authority.

brief.objective: Find ownership evidence for the bounded-packet documentation seam.
proof_obligations: Cite each ownership claim and search scope.
non_goals: Do not edit files or infer repository-wide absence.
stop_when: The named documentation surfaces answer the question or the basis changes.

result.summary: Ownership guidance is present in the root router and worker manual; no separate packet owner is named in the searched surfaces.

findings.claim: No separate packet owner was found in the named documentation scope.

proof.claim: The named documentation surfaces were searched.

uncertainty: This is scoped evidence, not a repository-wide ownership claim.
result.recommended_next_action: Return the scoped result to the root synthesis.

cases.name: external-oracle-research
cases.purpose: Verify a capability against the installed supported runtime before configuration.

brief.objective: Verify whether the installed supported runtime exposes the proposed direct-child capability.
proof_obligations: Record the capability or an explicit unsupported result.
non_goals: Do not edit repository configuration or infer support from issue text.
stop_when: The capability is directly verified or unsupported.

result.summary: The proposed configuration key was not established by the installed runtime reference.

findings.claim: The installed runtime does not yet provide evidence for the proposed configuration key.

evidence.note: The supported runtime help was inspected directly.

proof.claim: The installed supported runtime reference was inspected.

uncertainty: A different supported runtime version may expose a different capability.
result.recommended_next_action: Return to #4196 and keep configuration source-gated until capability research is settled.

cases.name: adversarial-plan-contradiction
cases.purpose: Preserve a contradiction instead of converting repeated claims into agreement.

brief.objective: Challenge whether the plan premise is supported by independent current evidence.
proof_obligations: Separate author claims from independent evidence and retain contradictions.
non_goals: Do not rewrite the plan or decide by comment count.
stop_when: The premise is supported, contradicted, or evidence is unavailable.

result.summary: The plan says the adapter capability is available, while the independent runtime reference does not establish it.

proof.claim: The installed runtime reference was inspected.

uncertainty: The issue and its comments are one source, not independent confirmations.
result.recommended_next_action: Return to the issue and resolve the capability contradiction before writing configuration.

cases.name: compiled-spec-writer
cases.purpose: Give one admitted writer a single explicit edit cage and proof boundary.

brief.objective: Implement only the accepted lexical extractor slice from the compiled builder view.
proof_obligations: Run the focused extractor proof and record the exact implementation head.
non_goals: Do not widen the extractor into a provider change or the deferred follow-up PRs.
stop_when: The edit cage is insufficient, the spec is stale, or the exact proof boundary is reached.

result.summary: The accepted lexical extractor slice was written inside the admitted cage and its focused proof passed locally.

changes.summary: Implemented the accepted per-body lexical extractor slice.

proof.claim: The writer reports that the focused extractor proof passed locally.

uncertainty: Independent current-head review is still owed.
result.recommended_next_action: Publish the branch and request exact-head review.

cases.name: exact-head-independent-review
cases.purpose: Review one published head and name the head in the result.

brief.objective: Review the example corpus for contract minimality and exact-head correctness.
proof_obligations: Name the reviewed head and report only evidence-backed findings.
non_goals: Do not edit the branch or approve stale evidence.
stop_when: The head changes or the bounded review is complete.

result.summary: The example corpus is bounded, names its authorities, and keeps mutation authority out of read-only cases at head 89abcdef01234567.

proof.claim: The corpus was reviewed at the published exact head.

result.recommended_next_action: Continue with current-head CI and integration adjudication.

cases.name: ci-failure-triage-with-overflow
cases.purpose: Classify a failure without copying a complete log into the root result.

brief.objective: Classify the failing check against the current PR head and retain complete logs by reference.
proof_obligations: Distinguish product, test, policy, instrument, flaky, and stale-head classes.
non_goals: Do not repair production code or paste raw logs into the result.
stop_when: The failure class is evidenced or the current-head log is unavailable.

result.summary: The check stopped in runner setup; no product, test, policy, instrument, flaky, or stale-head conclusion is proven from the current log.

proof.claim: The check stopped before its repository proof step.

uncertainty: A rerun is required before assigning a repository failure class.
result.recommended_next_action: Park the runner blocker and rerun against the same exact head.

overflow.reason: Complete runner log retained outside the root-facing result.

cases.name: cleanup-salvage-audit
cases.purpose: Reconcile only artifacts created by one completed lane.

brief.objective: Classify the lane worktree and branch after merge without touching ambiguous work.
proof_obligations: Preserve unpublished or ambiguous artifacts and cite every cleanup decision.
non_goals: Do not remove unrelated worktrees, branches, or scratch files.
stop_when: Every lane-created artifact is KEEP, REMOVE, SALVAGE, or REVIEW.

result.summary: The merged lane worktree is removable; an unrelated worktree is preserved as REVIEW rather than guessed safe to delete.

findings.claim: The lane-created worktree can be removed after merge.
An unrelated worktree remains ambiguous and must be preserved.

uncertainty: The unrelated worktree owner was not established.
result.recommended_next_action: Remove only the lane-created worktree and record the unrelated artifact for review.

cases.name: single-agent-control
cases.purpose: Reject delegation when the task is narrower than packet setup and join cost.
cases.task: Fix one spelling error in the file already open in the current worktree.
cases.reason: The change has one file, one obvious edit, no independent research, and no useful bounded fan-out; packet setup would exceed the work itself.
non_goals: Do not create a child brief, role, queue, scheduler entry, or result record.
